name: Encrypted Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Encrypted Memorandum guides new rogues to their trainer. Solm Hargrin disguises his invitation as official communication and calls scoundrels in exile to stand together.

sections.title: A Discrete Summons
sections.body: In Anvilmar, rogues keep their presence quiet. Their trainer, Solm Hargrin, uses the Encrypted Memorandum to reach recruits without approaching them in plain view. Disguised as a directive from distant superiors, the coded parchment tells fledgling rogues where to find a mentor while avoiding the attention of local guards and suspicious townsfolk.

sections.title: Kinship in Coldridge
sections.body: Solm Hargrin's cipher offers practical counsel to rogues in Coldridge Valley. Gnomeregan has fallen, and displaced gnomes now crowd into Dun Morogh's snowbound settlements alongside their dwarven allies. Tensions remain close to the surface. Solm urges his students to look out for one another, since scapegoating and prejudice can make rogues answer for every missing trinket.

faq.answer: The Encrypted Memorandum is a coded parchment delivered to beginning rogues in Coldridge Valley. It directs them to seek training under the guise of an official dispatch.
Solm Hargrin wrote the memorandum. The rogue trainer in Anvilmar disguises it as official orders to gather fellow scoundrels discreetly.
Rogues in Coldridge Valley avoid public scrutiny. The disguise makes the invitation look like routine official business, keeping local authorities and curious onlookers from noticing the training.
Solm Hargrin wants to offer combat training, guidance, and mutual protection. He urges rogues to stick together in crowded Dun Morogh, where thieves are quickly blamed for missing items.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can use this coded letter to find your trainer in Anvilmar and answer his summons in Dun Morogh.
As a gnome, you live among dwarven allies after Gnomeregan's fall. This note offers gnomish rogues a quiet call for solidarity and survival.
